new_blocker_S11.mechanism: src/repository_presenter/components/readme/repair/targeted.py:507-525 (_resolve_change_path) strips only a leading '$.' token before walking a changes[].path; it does not strip a leading 'revised_output.' token. _uncorroborated_changes (targeted.py:528-562) calls it with original=target.output (repair/rounds.py:584, the causal stage's own stored output, unwrapped - no top-level 'revised_output' key) and revised=output.get('revised_output') (targeted.py:602, also unwrapped by the time it is passed in). When the model's own changes[].path is 'revised_output.units[2].text' - a reasonable reading of 'the JSON path it touched' given the output schema's own top-level required key is literally named revised_output (prompts/targeted_repair.yaml:58, :80, no worked example given) - both _resolve_change_path(original, path) and _resolve_change_path(revised, path) fail at the first segment ('revised_output' not a key of either unwrapped document) and both return the module's _UNRESOLVED sentinel (targeted.py:499-504).
